problem_framing.reason: A1 separates the objective (whether public evidence justifies investment) from the suggested solution. It lists rivals to a consumer proposition: B2B portfolio extension, no expansion, a route-to-market change and a different commercial segment. It also requires a demand, willingness-to-pay or route-to-market test and attention to the B2B model. It does not reach 3. No constraint is found that a good analyst would not want missed, such as Belimo's existing 2015 residential product line (belimo-achr-residential-2015). Alternative 5 also muddles 'residential building owners' into the commercial segment. The €20,000 / 12-week budget is an unlabelled framing assumption, not an observed fact. It is acceptable as a test constraint but should be read as assumed.
